trust_decision.summary: Whether a raw Java class name taken from the JMS type-id message property may be loaded as the Jackson target type; decided (opt-in, via a trusted-packages allowlist) in getJavaTypeForMessage of the JMS Jackson converters, before ClassUtils.forName.

landing_point.why: Summary names the Jackson JMS converters; the unchecked ClassUtils.forName(typeId) on a message property is the only remaining unchecked class load, and the identical check already sits in JacksonJsonMessageConverter.java:484 next door.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API MappingJackson2MessageConverter.fromMessage(Message) (line 237), reached from JmsTemplate.receiveAndConvert / listener adapters
fix_sites.module_kind: deprecated legacy implementation (Jackson 2) of the main JMS JSON converter

fix_sites.entry_point: new public setter setTrustedPackages(String...) (fix.diff:65-67) plus private isTrustedPackage helper (fix.diff:75-90)
fix_sites.module_kind: configuration API on the same class

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The only second implementation, spring-jms/src/main/java/org/springframework/jms/support/converter/JacksonJsonMessageConverter.java:484-487, is already fixed at the pinned commit (parent commit fe68e337b2 'Add trusted packages to JacksonJsonMessageConverter').

O3_reason_to_dismiss: MappingJackson2MessageConverter is @Deprecated(forRemoval) (MappingJackson2MessageConverter.java:63-65), so a solver could argue only the Jackson 3 converter matters; but that one is already patched, which removes the lever.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Converter must still resolve configured typeIdMappings ids and, when no trusted packages are set, keep loading any class name (opt-in, backward compatible); arrays like [Lpkg.Type; of trusted types must work.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a convertFromMessage override path (e.g. MapMessage/ObjectMessage support) that resolves its own type id from a different property without the allowlist
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Javadoc invites subclasses to support other message types via this template method; a maintainer adding MapMessage support could re-read a type hint directly.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a hint-based fromMessage(Message, Object conversionHint) overload resolving a type from the header before falling back, bypassing getJavaTypeForMessage
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: toMessage already has a conversionHint overload; a symmetric read-side overload is a plausible addition.

O9_family: CWE-502 deserialization of untrusted data (attacker-chosen polymorphic target class via message property)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Copy JacksonJsonMessageConverter's setTrustedPackages/isTrustedPackage verbatim into MappingJackson2MessageConverter, which is exactly the published fix.

out_of_scope_notes: The pinned commit already contains the identical fix plus tests in JacksonJsonMessageConverter (JacksonJsonMessageConverter.java:79,123-125,190-205,484-487; JacksonJsonMessageConverterTests.java:138-202), so a solver has a ready template; repinning to fe68e337b2^ would make the task two adjacent WHERE-type sites in one package, still weak.
spring-messaging converters take the target class from the handler signature, not a message header, so they are not routes to this sink.
